text:
Ramy Brook
Graphic Design
Format: Graphic Design
Focus: Movement / Type / Image

As a marketing intern at Ramy Brook, I worked closely with the art director to create visual assets across email, social media, and digital campaigns. I supported graphic design and photo editing needs, helping shape seasonal campaigns that stayed true to the brand's color palette, typography, and overall aesthetic. My goal was always to make the layouts visually clear and engaging while enhancing the stories each campaign aimed to tell.
